constraints.name: Dependency
constraints.statement: The more complex a society, the more dependent it becomes.
constraints.injunction: Flag increasing systemic dependency in any proposal that adds infrastructural complexity.

constraints.name: Entropy
constraints.injunction: Never present infrastructure as stable without ongoing maintenance in long-term planning.

constraints.name: Aging
constraints.injunction: Include a finite lifespan and increasing failure risk with age in any infrastructure assessment.

constraints.name: Cascades
constraints.statement: One failure can bring everything down.
constraints.injunction: Assess cascading failure risk in any analysis of interconnected infrastructure systems.

constraints.name: Cost
constraints.statement: Building is expensive; maintaining is more expensive still.
constraints.injunction: Include full lifecycle cost, maintenance included, in any infrastructure budget estimate.

constraints.name: Saturation
constraints.injunction: Systematically compare projected demand to real capacity before recommending use of an infrastructure.

constraints.name: Climate
constraints.statement: Infrastructure is not adapted to the current climate.
constraints.injunction: Flag any infrastructure design based on historical climate norms that are now outdated.

constraints.name: Rigidity
constraints.injunction: Flag the difficulty of adapting existing infrastructure to a new need or context.

constraints.name: Fragmentation
constraints.injunction: Do not assume the continuity of an infrastructure network without checking its potential breaking points.

constraints.name: Repair
constraints.injunction: Systematically assess the real repairability of an infrastructure before recommending it as a durable solution.
